technique_name: Analyze the impact of technology on media and entertainment.
description: Technology has had a profound impact on the media and entertainment industry. From streaming services to digital formats, the way we consume and interact with media has been completely revolutionized. Technology has enabled faster and easier distribution of content, with streaming services enabling the delivery of TV, movies, and music at the click of a button.
